notes.title: Train Station Renovation - Germany DLC - Important Announcement - Release Date
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Renovators![/h1]

[h2]We are changing the date of release for Train Station Renovation - Germany DLC.[/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33426656/5122e278ebc23179b9b25aa02ac6a76c2446026e.png[/img]

As we value honesty in our communication with you we want to be as transparent regarding the cause of that change as possible.

We have reconsidered the launch date for Train Station Renovation - Germany DLC due to market conditions. 

A number of similar games released in the last weeks have not achieved as much of a success as would be otherwise expected. We think that timing has a big part in this - having the option to wait for a better launch window, we want to ask for your patience for another 2 months and launch the game mid-January. 

Better launch conditions convert to higher chances that the DLC will be profitable - [u]thus allowing us to support the title for far longer period of time[/u]. A failed launch of a good DLC is something we really want to avoid for obvious reasons.

We believe we can find a better alternative date of release that will let you play the game and focus on the much needed relaxation that we know our DLC will provide. What is more - we believe that the new date of release will correlate better with other productions and games coming out on Steam. We want to add to your overall gaming experience and finding the right moment for release of our game is of vital importance in that regard. 

We are absolutely certain that you will have a lot of fun with our DLC and as soon as we decide on a new release date for the game we'll announce it publicly immediately. 

We are sorry for the inconvenience this change causes and we truly hope for your understanding in that matter. 

[i]As a small token of our apologies we're hosting a giveaway for Train Station Renovation on our Discord - be sure to join in as we have 10 keys to give out - click on the link below![/i]

[u]Thank you for your continuous support![/u] 

Best regards,
Train Station Renovation Team

[url=https://discord.gg/waxCHt3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: We already know the release date of Train Station Renovation
notes.notes:
[b][h1]Hi Railfans![/h1][/b]

We have finally arrived at the station. We are super excited that after a year and a half of development and hard work and doubling our efforts we want tell you - the date for the game release is:

[b][h2]30th April 2020[/h2][/b]
But this is not all! During this time of waiting, Train Station Renovation Demo will be available on Steam. We are super excited to finally let you onto the platform! After months of constant improvements during the beta period, it feels great to share our work with all of you.

[previewyoutube=VHoo9Hg5OZA;full][/previewyoutube]

In this demo version of the game, the tutorial and first level will be available for players! You, as the player, will be able to fully experience one of at least 10 levels that we are planning in our final game. You will be able to fully renovate the station from graffiti, trash and ruined walls, you will be able to buy and fit out the station and platform, the way you want!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33426656/e8ab9480388e40fb2d5ff78bbaeba9c53102a148.png[/img]

Train Station Renovation is renovation sim that - we believe - will let the players immerse themselves into the game and play with the unique furnituring and renovating system. The gameplay is calming and relaxing, just what you need in these crazy times. 

The game is polished and bug free. However, as is with games, you may encounter some new bugs which we have not found before. However, we are committed to correcting any errors you may find. If you find an anything, let us know via discussion board or social media. Our whole team will work around the clock to make sure that any problems will be addressed ASAP.


[b][i] We assure you that you will be hearing a lot from us as we'll stay in touch constantly. Stay tuned and have fun! [/i][/b]

Yours,
Live Motion Games!

PS: Stay home and play games! :)

[b]FAQ:[/b]
Q: How many levels are available for this demo? 
A: The tutorial and first level are fully playable.

Q: How do I play the game? 
A: Start with the tutorial - it will explain the mechanics to you.
 
Q: What kind of tools will I be able to use in the demo? 
A: All entry level tools will be available. In the full game, the tools change into more advanced ones. 

Q: How many levels will there be in the final game? 
A: We will release X levels in the early access with more to follow.

Q: What will be the final price of the game? 
A: The final price will be revealed soon (similar price to similar games).

Q: Will I be able to load my save from the demo game in the final product? 
A: Yes, you will be! Once the game is released you should load your game and go to the second level straight away!
